name: Single-Agent Doxorubicin for Uterine Leiomyosarcoma
cyclesNote: six cycles were used in the referenced GeDDiS trial; continue per response and cumulative anthracycline ceiling, physician determined

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Single agent doxorubicin is a cytotoxic backbone for uterine leiomyosarcoma and is not biomarker restricted. ER/PR expression may guide endocrine therapy in selected uLMS but does not gate this regimen. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Uterine Neoplasms v3.2026, Systemic Therapy for Uterine Sarcoma (UTSARC-C).

supportiveCare: antiemetics: doxorubicin is moderate to high emetic risk (regimen dependent); prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
cardiac surveillance: baseline LVEF and cumulative anthracycline dose tracking (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2).
monitoring: cardiac function (LVEF) at baseline and as clinically indicated

doseModificationRules.condition: cumulative doxorubicin approaching 450 mg/m2 (warn) or 550 mg/m2 (hard)
doseModificationRules.text: Warn at 450 mg/m2 and stop at the 550 mg/m2 hard cap; reassess cardiac function; physician decides on continuation.

doseModificationRules.condition: decline in LVEF or clinical cardiotoxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and obtain cardiology review before further anthracycline.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 175842. DOXOrubicin 75 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 21 days (GeDDiS trial single agent arm; the narrative at line 175956 states doxorubicin is an appropriate first line option). Anthracycline cumulative lifetime cap: warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2 (conventional anthracycline ceiling). Tall man per ISMP. Track cumulative dose; obtain baseline and periodic cardiac assessment.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 175842 (single-agent doxorubicin at 75 mg/m2 every 3 weeks, GeDDiS trial comparator)
